Record Class PulsarSource

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.apache.pulsar.spring.function.PulsarSource
Record Components:
config - the source details
stopPolicy - the action to take on the source when the server is stopped
updateOptions - the options to use during an update operation (optional)
All Implemented Interfaces:
PulsarFunctionOperations<org.apache.pulsar.common.io.SourceConfig>
public record PulsarSource(org.apache.pulsar.common.io.SourceConfig config, PulsarFunctionOperations.FunctionStopPolicy stopPolicy, @Nullable org.apache.pulsar.common.functions.UpdateOptions updateOptions) extends Record implements PulsarFunctionOperations<org.apache.pulsar.common.io.SourceConfig>
Represents a Pulsar Source backed by a SourceConfig.
